mcq_drop.why: opinion item (comparative 'national presence' of leaders), not examinable fact

patterns: APPSC asks titles directly (Bharat Kokila = Sarojini Naidu) and pairs: founder-organisation (Servants of India = Gokhale, not Motilal; Bal Charkha Sangh = Indira; Independence for India League = Nehru).
APPSC Group-2 asks Pingali Venkayya's flag model year (1921) and Andhra leaders; work-author pairs (Sarvodaya = Gandhi, Jana Gana Mana = Tagore).
Other PSCs: Khaksars-Socialist Party-ILP-Forward Bloc match, Liberal Federation after Montford, Golden Threshold, Iqbal, 'light has gone out' = Nehru.
Traps: Servants of India vs Servants of the People; Mahatma (Tagore) vs Father of the Nation (Bose); Bhikaiji Cama abroad vs Aruna Asaf Ali Gowalia Tank.
App relies heavily on multi-statement and match items; APPSC uses mostly direct one-liners plus occasional pair items.
